title: 🆕 New Pair: 0x50d0025bed0010f403... on robinhood
summary:
Zyrs Nasdaq Buyback Protocol, $ZYRS, plans to use trading fees to buy shares in real Nasdaq listed companies, starting with the smallest that clears its public queue.

The planned on-chain default is 90% signal treasury for acquisitions, 10% burned. Deployment is pending. The planned purchase route runs through a brokerage account, with the date, shares, price and broker confirmation id published for every purchase. The brokerage account and receipt system are pending.

The queue computes market cap from shares outstanding filed with the SEC, times the last sale. Every row links to the filing. Companies are screened for share type, price, daily trading value, SEC-computed market cap and data sanity.

The queue is available as JSON or CSV with no key and no signup. Holders earn nothing from holding. Launch through @ponsdotfamily is planned.
